message: 唇が触れそうな距離

name: Nanaka
message: 「So Azel didn't end up coming to school after all...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Misa
message: 「She wasn't acting like her usual self at all, either...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could it be some kind of ill effect from when she descended to the Human World...?」

name: Ria
message: 「I checked the dorms too, but she wasn't there.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Ria
message: 「Azel-san... don't you think she's hiding something from us?」

name: Synn
message: 「Most likely. That wasn't the first time Azel and Bylous had met.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You mean they already knew each other?」

name: Synn
message: 「Probably, yes. And they understand each other's goals.」

name: Misa
message: 「In that case, Bylous attacked her to stop Azel-san from achieving her goal.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Unforgivable! Targeting Azel-san, of all people!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We have to find Azel as soon as possible and protect her.」

name: Misa
message: 「It would be terrible if she got attacked again.」

name: Helena
message: 「I wonder about that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, Big Sis.」

name: Helena
message: 「Do you really think enemies would get the chance to talk over each other's goals?」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Helena
message: 「This is purely hypothetical, of course, but right now we're unconditionally assuming Azel-chan is on our side.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you saying Azel is an enemy?」

name: Helena
message: 「At the very least, her goal is heading in a different direction from ours.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And in that man, Bylous, I sense a deep conviction.」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san!」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm sorry. It pains me to make you all doubt a friend, but...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It means the possibility has arisen that Azel was cooperating with Bylous.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, with Bylous...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「T-That can't be true!! Azel would never...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Why can you say that with such certainty?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, um...」

name: Helena
message: 「Lolotte. This is strictly a hypothetical. Let's calm down and think this through.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, even if they were allies, I don't see why he'd attack Azel.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Bylous abandoned even his own ally, Soltia. Assuming he would save her was a miscalculation on my part.」

name: Helena
message: 「If I had to guess, Bylous and his kind never had the kind of camaraderie we feel every day in the first place--」

name: Helena
message: 「It was a friendly alliance formed merely to achieve a goal. The sort of relationship where betrayal wouldn't be surprising at any moment.」

name: Ria
message: 「How could...」

name: Synn
message: 「To think I was cowering in the face of a power like that...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot. I can't lose to Bylous... I don't want to lose!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You wish to become stronger. Even to the point of surpassing me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course. Because--」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa.」

name: Synn
message: 「And Ria.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not fighting Bylous with my strength alone.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if you surpass me, there is no guarantee you will win. Knowing that, you still intend to challenge Bylous?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if the odds are only 1%, it's definitely worth a try.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, looks like someone copied me.\s07」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Everything up to this point was merely a warm-up. I will accept no whining from here on out.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yes, ma'am!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, shoot!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmm... What's wrong, Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「I forgot to give Helena-san the budget plan.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Your head's been full of stuff like the Bylous. Can't be helped.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really want to use that as an excuse, though. A student's primary duty is Student Council activities, after all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, true.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wait, hey!!」
When I called their home, I was told both sisters were still at the academy.
I dash at full speed toward the chairwoman's office.
Faintly, some unusually moody and rhythmic music is playing.
C-Could this be one of the academy's seven mysteries...?
E-Eek, I need to get to the chairwoman's office fast\s01

name: Synn
message: 「E-E-Excuse me.\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Welco~me♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-Wh-What are you two doing at this hour, holding hands and hugging each other like that.\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be forbidden sisterly love...!?」
No way... So Ria-senpai really is just like how Misa drew her--

name: Ria
message: 「You've got it wrong, Synn-kun! Don't jump to weird conclusions!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then what were you doing?」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's... This is, um...」

name: Helena
message: 「'Hey, do you have the goods yet?'」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Aah! Sorry, I'm so sorry.」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, good work♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis. So you knew Synn-kun was coming.」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, that's right. Mother contacted me about it.」

name: Ria
message: 「Then you should've told me from the start, geez!!」

name: Synn
message: 「So, Senpai, what were you and Helena-san doing?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, Synn-chan. Since it's cold, you should finish off that Stolichnaya over there before heading back.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, thank you very much. Gulp, gulp.」

name: Helena
message: 「Heeey, hold on a sec--!」

name: Synn
message: 「Pwaaah--!!」

name: Synn
message: 「So good--」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is Stolichnaya?」

name: Helena
message: 「It's vodka... I was only joking...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hebuh.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Alright, with this, Ria's secret is safe.」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't give me 'alright', geez!」

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, I'll leave the rest to you!」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Hey, hold it. Don't run away--!」

name: Ria
message: 「...Geez... Big Sis really...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, are you okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Ria
message: 「Thank goodness... looks like he's just asleep...」

name: Synn
message: 「Mm... nnh... Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「...! Even when he's asleep, he's thinking about me...」

name: Ria
message: 「Just on the cheek should be fine, right...」

name: Helena
message: 「I brought a stretcher~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Aaaaah, w-w-w-w-waaah!」
